sections.title: ② 今日文法｜Part 6 篇章邏輯、句子插入、分詞與要求式假設語氣
sections.markdown:
主題：**Part 6 篇章邏輯、句子插入、分詞與要求式假設語氣**

### 規則 1

`However / Therefore / Meanwhile / In addition`

> The manual is ready. However, the checklist still needs approval.

However 表轉折；Therefore 表結果；Meanwhile 表同時；In addition 表補充。依上下文關係選擇，而非只看單句。

### 規則 2

`Sentence insertion: pronoun reference`

> The revised forms are available. These documents replace the previous versions.

插入句的 this/these/it/they 必須有清楚的先行詞；也要檢查前後文的指涉與順序。

### 規則 3

`Sentence insertion: chronology and action`

> Safety will approve the checklist on Thursday. After that, the team will circulate it.

先完成核准，再傳送文件。辨識 first, once, after that, then 等時間順序。

### 規則 4

`Reduced relative clause: past participle`

> The charges listed on the invoice are billable.

charges that are listed → charges listed，表示被動修飾。

### 規則 5

`Mandative subjunctive: require that + S + base verb`

> The supervisor required that each form be signed.

要求、建議、堅持類動詞後的 that 子句，在正式用法中採原形動詞；被動用 be + p.p.。

### 規則 6

`Only after / Not until inversion`

> Only after the review ended did the manager authorize payment.

限制副詞片語置句首，主句使用助動詞倒裝。

### 規則 7

`Provided that / Unless / In case`

> The shipment can proceed provided that inspection is complete.

provided that = 只要；unless = 除非；in case = 以防。

sections.title: 03 Listening｜Updated Safety Manual
sections.markdown:
先聽後作答，提交後顯示逐字稿與解析；可使用 TTS 播放原創英語逐字稿。

聽力稿：

> Man: Can we distribute the revised safety manual to the branches this morning?
> Woman: I would wait. Operations has approved the instructions, but Safety is still checking the emergency diagrams. The review should finish by two. If the diagrams are approved, we can send the complete package by four.
> Man: Should I tell the branches that the manual is ready?
> Woman: Tell them a new version is being prepared, but do not send the manual alone. Please draft the announcement and hold it until Safety confirms.

sections.title: 04 Listening｜Temperature-Controlled Delivery
sections.markdown:
先聽後作答，提交後顯示逐字稿與解析；可使用 TTS 播放原創英語逐字稿。

聽力稿：

> Woman: We need twenty sample containers delivered to the research lab by ten thirty Tuesday morning. Temperature control and a signed receipt are mandatory, and our budget is three hundred dollars.
> Man: Option B is inexpensive but has no temperature control. Option C arrives ten minutes too late. Option D arrives on time, but the carrier does not obtain a signature.
> Woman: That leaves Option A. Please reserve it and forward the tracking details to the lab.

sections.title: 05 Listening｜Registration Portal Update
sections.markdown:
先聽後作答，提交後顯示逐字稿與解析；可使用 TTS 播放原創英語逐字稿。

聽力稿：

> Attention, workshop participants. The registration portal was originally scheduled to reopen on Thursday at one in the afternoon. The vendor now expects access to be restored at four. During the outage, people who have already downloaded their preparation materials may read them offline, but new registrations cannot be submitted. The deadline for this Friday's workshop has been extended from Thursday at five to Friday at noon. Automatic reminders may still display the old deadline; the extension remains valid. If the portal is not restored by four, an additional notice will appear on the support page.

sections.title: ⑥ Reading｜On-Site Inspection: Billing and Next-Month Credit
sections.markdown:
限時：**8 分 30 秒**。

### On-Site Service Terms

> A standard on-site inspection call costs $480. Labor costs $90 per hour, billed in 30-minute increments and rounded up to the next half hour; a minimum of two billable hours applies. A $120 after-hours surcharge applies if actual work begins after 6:00 P.M. A $200 deposit paid in advance is credited against the current invoice balance. If a technician arrives more than 45 minutes after the scheduled appointment, the customer receives a $100 service credit on the following month's invoice. Service credits do not reduce the current invoice.

用途：service_terms

### Alder Research — November Service Record

> Appointment: November 12 at 5:30 P.M. Technician arrival: 6:20 P.M. Actual work: 6:30 P.M. to 9:10 P.M. The inspection was not canceled. A $200 deposit had already been paid. The November invoice covers the call fee, billable labor, and any applicable after-hours surcharge, less the deposit. The customer is checking whether the technician's delay changes the amount currently due.

用途：work_order

### Vendor Confirmation and December Quote

> We confirm that the technician arrived 50 minutes late, so Alder Research will receive a $100 credit on its December invoice, not the November invoice. November's outstanding balance remains $670. A separate December preventive check is quoted at the standard $480 call fee plus two hours of labor ($180). It is scheduled to begin at 3:00 P.M., so no after-hours surcharge applies. An optional replacement filter costs $85. The December service credit will reduce the December invoice by $100. Your December budget is $620. To add the filter, please reply by November 25; it will not be added automatically.

用途：vendor_email

sections.markdown:
正式限時：**5 分鐘**。

### Listening Q37-L1

聽力稿：

> Woman: The contractor can deliver sixteen replacement keyboards on Monday. The remaining nine will arrive Wednesday. Tuesday's orientation requires only fourteen, so we do not need to delay it. Please send the first shipment to the training desk.

### Listening Q37-L2

聽力稿：

> Notice: The supplier briefing will begin at 10:15 A.M. on Friday instead of 9:45 A.M. The meeting room is unchanged. Anyone needing interpretation should email Administration by Thursday at 2 P.M.

### Reading Q37-R1

> A printer charges $32 per workbook. Orders of 25 or more receive a 10% discount on the workbook subtotal only. Delivery costs $24 and is not discounted. A department orders 25 workbooks and has a budget of $760.

### Reading Q37-R2

> General rule: Changes made after November 15 incur a $45 fee. Update: Because the provider moved the November 24 seminar to November 26, affected registrants may change their bookings without a fee through November 20. Nora registered for November 24 and requested a change on November 19.

sections.title: ⑨ 複習與錯題分類
sections.markdown:
回顧前 **[32, 33, 34, 35, 36] 天**，完成 **[{'prompt': 'Scarcely _____ the briefing begun when the alert sounded.', 'answer': 'had', 'tag': 'G'}, {'prompt': 'No sooner _____ the meeting ended than the client called.', 'answer': 'had', 'tag': 'G'}, {'prompt': 'Only after the audit ended _____ the team publish the report.', 'answer': 'did', 'tag': 'G'}, {'prompt': 'The director required that the document _____ signed.', 'answer': 'be', 'tag': 'G'}, {'prompt': 'Despite _____ the email, the customer called again.', 'answer': 'receiving', 'tag': 'G'}, {'prompt': 'The number of tickets _____ fallen.', 'answer': 'has', 'tag': 'AGR'}, {'prompt': 'A number of suppliers _____ responded.', 'answer': 'have', 'tag': 'AGR'}, {'prompt': 'I would hold off. → 中文意思？', 'answer': '建議暫緩執行', 'tag': 'IMP'}, {'prompt': 'Credit / refund / reimbursement 差別？', 'answer': '帳款抵用／退款／費用報銷', 'tag': 'V'}, {'prompt': '更新公告與舊提醒衝突時應採用？', 'answer': '適用的最新公告', 'tag': 'U'}, {'prompt': '服務抵用額明訂次月折抵，是否可直接扣本月？', 'answer': '不可；依合約在次月折抵', 'tag': 'E'}, {'prompt': 'Part 6 插入句有 These documents 時先確認什麼？', 'answer': '前文是否已出現可指代的複數文件', 'tag': 'P'}] 張**複習卡。

先遮住答案，90 秒快答；錯題於 24 小時後再測。未取得歷史實際錯題，故使用跨日核心複習。

錯題標籤：

- `G`：文法（倒裝、假設語氣、分詞、被動）
- `AGR`：主詞動詞一致
- `V`：單字與搭配詞
- `POS`：詞性
- `P`：Part 6 篇章邏輯／句子插入
- `L`：聽力明示資訊
- `IMP`：隱含意圖
- `I`：資訊整合
- `T`：時間與期限
- `U`：更新資訊
- `E`：例外條款
- `CAL`：計算
- `BUD`：預算限制
- `N`：下一步動作

sections.title: ⑩ 今日作業
sections.markdown:
- 30 個單字複習兩輪，選 8 個造句；其中 3 句用於帳單與文件核准情境。（約 15 分鐘）
- Part 5 15 題在 225 秒內作答；依錯題標籤複習。（約 10 分鐘）
- Listening 三組各聽兩次，第二次不看逐字稿並嘗試 1.1x。（約 25 分鐘）
- Reading 重算 11 月費用、12 月兩個方案，並標出每份文件的優先條件。（約 20 分鐘）
- Part 6 四題完成句子插入與篇章關係說明；12 題小考首次限時作答，複習後重測。（約 20 分鐘）
